key_values.event_name: September-October 2015 Singapore haze from Indonesian peat and forest fires

provenance.notes: Precipitation summaries are available-package stats objects for 2015-09-01 to 2015-10-16, not a full-window rainfall-clearing calculation. True-color gate validates openable image dimensions and pixel variation rather than file size alone.

criteria.description: Includes exactly the eight requested fields with valid JSON types and no extra fields.
criteria.name: Returned JSON shape
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if the ledger is recoverable but has one minor field-name or formatting issue.

criteria.description: Reports the locked 2015-09-01/2015-10-31 window, 61 inclusive days, and uses the relevant source summaries.
criteria.name: Event window and source fields
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the correct window with an off-by-one day count or incomplete source use.

criteria.description: Extracts 100 ppb and 1,300 ppb correctly, computes co_ratio 13.0, and computes co_excess_ppb 1200.
criteria.name: Carbon-monoxide arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct inputs with one rounding or subtraction error; award 1 point for recognizing the large CO increase without correct arithmetic.

criteria.description: Rounds WorldPop to 410885, computes zero Sentinel dNBR scenes, counts two available precipitation summaries with stats, and validates the true-color image pair as openable images with positive dimensions and pixel variation.
criteria.name: Exposure and data-availability values
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 1 point each for population, Sentinel scene total/status handling, precipitation count/window awareness, and true-color image validation.

criteria.description: Applies every threshold exactly and returns co_plume_exposure_supported_no_burnscar_map.
criteria.name: Gate logic and final label
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the right label with one missed gate, or for correct gates with a noncanonical label.

criteria.description: Keeps the response to the requested ledger and avoids uncomputed health, burn-area, or rainfall-causation details.
criteria.name: Compact interpretation discipline
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a correct ledger with minor extra prose that does not change the result.
